eventDetail.eventTitle: 2026 24th IEEE International Symposium on Network Computing and Applications (NCA)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing
eventDetail.scope: NCA is a successful series of conferences that serves as a large international forum for presenting and sharing recent research results and technological developments in the fields of Network and Cloud Computing. NCA reaches out to both researchers and practitioners, and to both academia and industry. The conference features keynotes, technical presentations, and workshops.
